clauses.title: CL-D108 records how a gate judges a corrected body claim
clauses.section: ## CL-D108 — A trusted timeline correction settles a body claim
requires: An uncorrected body claim is judged as CL-D95 says.
Letting a correction by an untrusted author or a bot settle a claim, or settling a claim the correction misstates, requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The shared Every-gate block carries the rule
requires: A pull-request body claim that a later conversation comment by a trusted author (owner, member or collaborator, not a bot) corrects is judged as corrected: the gate cites that comment and raises no finding against the body sentence, unless the correction itself is inaccurate against the head (CL-D108).

clauses.title: The rule is pinned in the block and in every gate payload
requires: Issue #242 the shared Every-gate block says a trusted timeline correction settles a body claim
Issue #242 the payload the launch builder writes carries the rule, for every gate of both roots

clauses.title: CL-D95 names the narrowing
requires: A body claim that is false at the head remains a finding under any template (CL-D108 later judged one that a trusted timeline comment corrects as corrected).
